entities.summary: Qazi Massarrat Hussain was a Pakistani field hockey player. He competed in the men's tournament at the 1956 Summer Olympics, winning silver, the country`s first ever Olympic medal in any sport. Hussain died in Karachi on 26 August 2021, at the age of 86.
